test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Enough money will have been saved by me for a new house by next year

options.text: I will be saving enough money for a new house by next year.
I will save enough money for a new house by next year.
I will have saved enough money for a new house by next year.
I will have been saving enough money for a new house by next year.

solution:
The correct answer is '**I will have saved enough money for a new house by next year**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice and it is in the present perfect tense.
 
• When we convert this sentence into an active voice, the subject 'Enough money' of the passive voice becomes the object, and the object 'me' becomes the subject 'I'.
 
• The passive format "have + been + V3 (saved)" should be converted into the active format "**have + **V3** (saved)**".
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the present perfect tense.
